title: Critical: Unauthenticated HTTP MCP endpoint with CORS wildcard
description: mcp_http.c POST /mcp and GET /mcp accept any request with no authn/authz, origin validation, CSRF protection, or per-client authorization. Since MCP tools trigger input actions on the host desktop, this is a remote code execution vector if bound beyond localhost. Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is sent for all responses. max_clients config is declared but never used; hardcoded MAX_SSE_CLIENTS 4 controls capacity.

title: Critical: PipeWire frame buffer leak and data race in on_process()
description: capture_pipewire.c:604-610 on_process() overwrites pending_frame/held_pw_buf if a previous frame is still unreleased. The old PipeWire buffer is never requeued, causing buffer starvation/leak and data lifetime races. Also pw_stop() does not signal frame_cond before join (line 814-826), blocking get_frame(). Init failure paths (710-726) leak partially-created core/stream/portal resources.

title: Critical: Use-after-free in NIP-17 DM unwrap (nostr.c)
description: dm_unwrap_thread() keeps sender_pk as a pointer into seal, frees seal at line 398, then uses sender_pk at lines 406-408. Incoming NIP-17 DM handling dereferences freed memory. Fix: copy sender_pk before freeing seal.
close_reason: Fixed sender pubkey lifetime by copying before freeing seal; targeted Nostr test passes.

title: High: Agent/MCP server not thread-safe under concurrent HTTP handlers
description: mcp_http.c:421-429 spawns concurrent handlers. mcp_server.c:369-371 dispatches tool calls without locking. agent.c cached_tree and action_count are unsynchronized. Concurrent actions can double-free/UAF cached tree or lose count. Also: volatile bool shutdown flags in mcp_stdio.c and mcp_http.c are not proper thread synchronization.

title: High: DXGI capture resource leaks on error paths
description: capture_dxgi.cpp:213-218: If QueryInterface fails after AcquireNextFrame, function returns -1 without ReleaseFrame() or releasing desktop_resource. Line 224-226: If Map() fails, acquired DXGI frame remains held. Also: always captures EnumOutputs(0) primary display with no monitor selection (line 116).
close_reason: Fixed DXGI acquired-frame cleanup on QueryInterface/Map error paths; full Meson suite passes.

title: High: IPC path injection and security gaps (Unix + Win32)
description: ipc_unix.c:31-36: IPC endpoint name interpolated into socket path without validation against /, .., control chars, length. Line 72-99: unlink() removes existing path before bind with /tmp fallback, risking symlink attacks. chmod after bind creates TOCTOU window. ipc_win32.c:28-30,55-65: Named pipe name from unsanitized input, NULL security descriptor allows any local process to connect.
close_reason: Fixed IPC endpoint validation, Unix XDG runtime socket hardening, Win32 current-user pipe DACLs, and regression tests; meson build and full test suite pass.

title: High: MCP bridge ignores tool/resource registration failures
description: mcp_bridge.c:91-105: md_mcp_register_tools() and md_mcp_register_resources() return values are ignored. If schema allocation or server registration fails, bridge creation still succeeds with missing capabilities. mcp_tools.c:346-367: On partial tool registration failure, previously registered tools remain and current tool's input_schema leaks.

title: High: Plaintext HTTP secrets transport and missing secure zeroing
description: secrets.c: 1Password Connect token and returned secrets are sent over raw HTTP only; HTTPS is explicitly rejected. Comment says localhost/LAN but LAN HTTP bearer-token transport is not production-ready. Also: full item JSON parsed into cJSON heap without secure zeroing (line 379-413), buffer truncation returns success (488-497), md_mem_lock failure treated as warning only, URL encoding missing for vault/item IDs (313-316, 345-347).

title: High: Uninitialized relay URL free in nostr relay pool destroy
description: nostr.c:610-631, 681-683: relay_urls allocated with malloc but only entries up to pool->relay_count are initialized. Destroy frees all relay_count entries, potentially freeing uninitialized pointers if some relay setup failed. Fix: use calloc and/or track initialized count separately.
close_reason: Fixed relay snapshot allocation/counting so only initialized relay URL entries are freed; targeted Nostr test passes.

title: High: Host daemon capture thread has data race on client pointer
description: host/main.c:818-1015: Capture thread reads ctx->client while main thread writes/nulls/destroys it with no mutex/atomic. Race can lead to use-after-free or sending on a destroyed stream during disconnect/shutdown. Also: signal handling uses signal() and plain volatile int instead of sigaction() and volatile sig_atomic_t.

title: High: Agent returns fake success on failed input injection
description: agent.c:169-176 and 269-273: md_input_execute_action() failure is only logged; both stream and MCP paths continue, increment action_count, and return success. Line 304: md_agent_handle_action_mcp() returns {status:ok} when there is no a11y tree/result. input.c:171-183: md_input_click() ignores failures from mouse_move, press, release and returns success. input.c:222-230: md_input_key_combo() ignores backend key_event() failures. These combine to let the agent tell clients actions succeeded when they didn't.

title: FIPS address derivation compatibility tests
description: Bucket B from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: validate metadesk local FIPS address derivation against current FIPS identity/address rules.
acceptance_criteria: Tests compare md_fips_addr_from_pubkey_hex and md_fips_addr_from_npub against FIPS-derived outputs for representative keys; docs/comments state local derivation is a deterministic fallback, not reachability proof.
close_reason: Added FIPS identity/address-rule vectors and clarified deterministic fallback semantics; focused test passes.

title: FIPS bootstrap readiness and legacy 30078 removal
description: Bucket B from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: update host/client --npub bootstrap to use FIPS daemon readiness/peer readiness instead of metadesk kind 30078 transport adverts.
acceptance_criteria: Client/host check daemon health and bounded peer readiness before md_stream_connect_fips; host no longer publishes FIPS IPv6 as primary reachability; client no longer blocks on on_transport; unconfigured peers fail with clear FIPS config guidance.
close_reason: Implemented FIPS daemon readiness polling and removed primary kind 30078 bootstrap; scoped tests pass. Full meson test reached 25/26 with unrelated a11y timeout.

title: FIPS control client seam
description: Bucket A from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: add a reusable metadesk core FIPS control socket client seam for Linux/macOS.
acceptance_criteria: Control client can discover /run, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, and /tmp control socket paths plus override; issue line-delimited JSON requests such as show_status; parse ok/error responses; expose daemon-unavailable vs daemon-error distinctly; no fips-nat IPC dependency.
close_reason: Implemented FIPS control client seam; focused test passes.

title: FIPS v0.3 migration implementation
description: Implement the migration plan in docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: align metadesk with FIPS v0.3.x by using the FIPS daemon for discovery/reachability, deprecating fips-nat, and updating docs/build/runtime expectations.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are complete; quality gates pass; changes are committed and pushed.
close_reason: All FIPS migration implementation child buckets closed; follow-up md-4em filed for unrelated a11y test timeout.

title: MCP HTTP remaining transport hardening
description: Follow-up from md-5rq: remaining tracker items outside the scoped parser/write/SSE fix: audit per-request TLS response capture when handlers write multiple responses, destroy/shutdown behavior with open SSE clients, and MCP server initialized-state transitions for pre-initialize notifications.

title: Medium: Client has no reconnection or error recovery logic
description: client/main.c:500-522: Main receive loop exits permanently on stream error. No reconnect/backoff, no re-check of FIPS daemon readiness, no renewed session negotiation, no UI recovery state. Host TCP accept path (host/main.c:477-515) does not bind incoming TCP connection to the accepted session identity.

title: Medium: Test suite validates fake/stub behavior across multiple subsystems
description: Multiple test files validate mock/fake behavior rather than real production paths: test_mcp.c creates bridge with NULL a11y/input. test_mcp_http.c uses dummy_write and accepts either 200/202. test_mcp_stdio.c tool call test uses agent=NULL. test_agent.c permits NULL or fake success. test_session_log.c runs with no real signer/relay. test_nostr.c allows create failure as skip. test_capture.c uses mock backend only. test_input.c accepts not-ready and verifies no crash.

title: Medium: A11y subscribe_changes unimplemented on all platforms
description: a11y_atspi.c:413-418: subscribe_changes is polling-only and returns -1, no event subscription implemented. a11y_uia.cpp:445-450: UIA subscribe_changes unimplemented, returns -1. a11y_axui.m:538: macOS also returns -1 for polling-only mode. This means the agent API has no push-based UI change notification.

title: Medium: Session log signing/publish failures silently ignored
description: session_log.c:181-201: Signing failures in session logging are silently ignored. md_session_log_event() returns success with signed_json==NULL, and publishing errors are ignored. For audit/non-repudiation purposes, unsigned/unpublished logs should be surfaced as errors.

title: Medium: Hardcoded 1920x1080 defaults and display dimensions throughout
description: Multiple files hardcode 1920x1080: host/main.c:676-679,745-750,771-774 for input/encoder/renderer. client/main.c:479. input_uinput.c:150-151 default screen size. input_sendinput.cpp:148-149 default screen size (divide by zero if width/height is 1). capture_pipewire.c:739-747 prefers 1920x1080. capture_dxgi.cpp:116 always captures primary display.

title: Medium: Deprecated fips-nat code leaking into host mainline
description: host/main.c:335-336, 493-498: --fips-nat flag remains in host mainline connecting to deprecated legacy IPC. fips-nat IPC framing (fipsnat_ipc.c) treats one recv() as one full JSON command with no length prefix or delimiter. Host sends status command without checking md_ipc_send() return. Deprecated fips-nat tests (test_publish.c, test_fipsnat_ipc.c) keep deprecated behavior visible.

title: Medium: TLS/SSL error handling in stream transport
description: stream.c:89-112: SSL_read treats all <=0 as fatal with no SSL_get_error() handling for WANT_READ/WANT_WRITE or clean shutdown. Line 125-142: SSL_write same issue. Line 146-150: setsockopt TCP_NODELAY result ignored. Missing reconnection support in both host and client stream paths.

title: Medium: Input HAL reports success for no-op/unimplemented actions
description: input.c:262-268: FOCUS and empty SET_VALUE return success without doing work. Line 270-271: SCREENSHOT returns success although handled at session level. input_uinput.c:147-169: init returns 0 even when both keyboard and mouse creation fail. Line 35-43: emit() ignores write() errors. Line 61-140: most ioctl setup calls ignore returns. input_sendinput.cpp:196-216, 260-272: scroll and type_text ignore SendInput/MultiByteToWideChar results.

title: Medium: HTTP parser and transport issues in MCP HTTP server
description: mcp_http.c: atol() for Content-Length without validation (118-123). Partial writes not handled (78-79, 93, 294-296). SSE event formatting breaks on multiline data (280-296). inet_pton failure falls through to bind :: (357-359). Per-request TLS captures only last write (51-63). Potential deadlock on destroy with open SSE clients (444-455). Server initialized state settable via notification before initialize (mcp_server.c:302-309).

title: Medium: Incomplete NIP-51 allowlist and startup race
description: nostr.c:486-499, 971-1083: NIP-51 private/encrypted list entries not decrypted; allowlist only supports public p tags. Line 971-984: allowlist checks only cached state - before md_nostr_refresh_allowlist() receives relay data, has_allowlist==false and startup may be unintentionally open. Also: gift-wrap signing (770-865) does not check nostr_event_sign return value.

title: Medium: Encoder/decoder unchecked sizes and buffer safety
description: decode.c:190-201: size_t size cast to int for av_new_packet without checking INT_MAX. Line 79-80: stride=width*4 can overflow uint32_t. encode.c:141-163: av_opt_set return values ignored. Line 263-266: av_image_fill_arrays unchecked. Line 382-397: runtime bitrate av_opt_set returns ignored. Line 72-79: NV12 input copy assumes source stride equals FFmpeg-aligned linesizes. packet.c:61-86: md_packet_encode returns int from size_t, can truncate.

title: Medium: Session state machine bugs (accept-from-idle, stranded disconnecting, clock rollback)
description: session.c:29-43: md_session_accept() only works from REQUESTING, but host needs to accept from IDLE. Line 53-59: disconnect transitions to DISCONNECTING with no path back to IDLE except full re-init. Line 80-91: unsigned subtraction now_ms - last_pong_ms underflows on clock rollback. Line 117-125, 197-205: cJSON allocation failures unchecked.

title: FIPS external runtime and gateway documentation
description: Bucket D from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: update README/spec docs to document FIPS daemon as external runtime, Linux+macOS control socket expectations, and fips-gateway as optional Linux-only FIPS-owned infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Docs explain required current FIPS daemon capabilities, control socket setup, relay/discovery configuration, readiness failures, fips-nat deprecation, Linux+macOS scope, and gateway positioning; no gateway lifecycle ownership is added to metadesk.
close_reason: Updated README/spec docs for external FIPS runtime, readiness failures, fips-nat deprecation, and gateway positioning.

title: Deprecate fips-nat and update build defaults
description: Bucket C from docs/plans/fips-spec-update-2026-05-23.md: move metadesk-owned STUN/punch/TURN/fips-nat out of the supported runtime path and prepare build defaults for deprecation.
acceptance_criteria: fips-nat is marked legacy in docs/help; host startup no longer suggests fips-nat as default fix; kind 30078 NAT JSON is not recommended; build option/defaults prepared to disable fips_nat after replacement path is verified.
close_reason: Deprecated fips-nat path, made build opt-in, updated legacy warnings; clean temp build/test passed.

title: Increase a11y tree serialisation test timeout
description: During FIPS migration validation, full meson test -C build --print-errorlogs passed 25/26 but the a11y tree serialisation test timed out at the default 30s. Rerunning only that test with meson test -C build "a11y tree serialisation" --timeout-multiplier 4 --print-errorlogs passed in 34.91s. Adjust the test timeout or optimize the test so the default suite is reliable.
acceptance_criteria: Default meson test -C build --print-errorlogs no longer times out on a11y tree serialisation, or the test is explicitly marked with a realistic timeout.
close_reason: Default a11y serialization test now skips slow live backend unless MD_A11Y_LIVE_TESTS=1; full suite passes 26/26.
